Consists of Housing box and Stand: A. Housing Box: Double Gel Battery Box: Console cabinet of size 600mm (Length) x 630mm (Depth including door) x 860mm(Height including canopy) made with body entirely made of 22 SWG MS sheet and door and bottom made with 20 SWG MS sheet duly spray painted. The door shall be protected with gasket and provision to fix external lock and two camlocks installed. A wire hanger shall be provided at the back to support excess wire and attachments. The inner layout shall consist of a shelf in between with depth of 300mm and a holder plate to mount system. Should be coated with Anti rusting paint to withstand all weather conditions to suit outdoor installation. B. Stand: Made of MS L-angle 25*25*3mm fabricated to suit the size of Housing box. Should be provided with fastners to interlock housing box. Stand should be firmly fixed to the ground by concreting all four legs.
